data.name: MarketplaceDisabled
data.value: The marketplace is switched off. An administrator can switch it on from the Marketplace page.

data.name: MarketplaceHostNotConfigured
data.value: The marketplace address is not set up correctly on this server, so the marketplace cannot be reached. Ask the person who installed the panel to check the marketplace setting.

data.name: MarketplaceUnreachable
data.value: The marketplace could not be reached. Modules that are already installed keep running. Please try again later.

data.name: CatalogueUnsigned
data.value: The marketplace answer could not be verified, so it was not used. Nothing was installed or changed.

data.name: CatalogueStale
data.value: The marketplace answer is too old to be trusted, so it was not used. Please check again in a few minutes.

data.name: CatalogueKeyMissing
data.value: This server has no marketplace verification key, so marketplace answers cannot be checked and nothing can be installed from it. Ask the person who installed the panel to restore it.

data.name: LeaseRequired
data.value: This module needs an active licence on this server. Install or renew the licence, then try again.

data.name: EntitlementMissing
data.value: Your licence does not include this module. You can get it from your Innovayse account, then try again.

data.name: IncompatiblePanel
data.value: This version of the module does not work with the version of the panel installed on this server.

data.name: PackageRevoked
data.value: This version of the module has been withdrawn by its publisher and cannot be installed.

data.name: GrantHostRefused
data.value: The marketplace sent a download address that this panel does not trust, so nothing was downloaded.

data.name: DownloadSizeMismatch
data.value: The downloaded package is not the size the marketplace announced, so it was discarded. Nothing was installed.

data.name: DownloadDigestMismatch
data.value: The downloaded package does not match the fingerprint the marketplace announced, so it was discarded. Nothing was installed.

data.name: ModuleNotInCatalogue
data.value: This module is not in the marketplace catalogue.

data.name: ModuleNotInstalled
data.value: This module is not installed.

data.name: ModuleOperationInProgress
data.value: Another operation on this module is still running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.

data.name: ModuleVersionNotInstallable
data.value: This version of the module cannot be installed. Choose a newer version.

data.name: InstallNotAcknowledged
data.value: Confirm that you have read what this module is allowed to do before installing it.

data.name: MarketplaceResponseInvalid
data.value: The marketplace sent an answer this panel could not understand, so it was not used.

data.name: MarketplaceResponseTooLarge
data.value: The marketplace sent more data than this panel accepts, so the answer was discarded.

data.name: MarketplaceRedirectRefused
data.value: The marketplace tried to send this panel to another address, which is not allowed, so the request was stopped.

data.name: MarketplaceRequestRefused
data.value: The marketplace refused the request. Nothing was installed or changed.

data.name: MarketplaceStorageUnavailable
data.value: The folder where downloaded packages are kept cannot be written to, so nothing was downloaded. Check the marketplace folder on the server.

data.name: ModuleAlreadyInstalled
data.value: This module is already installed at this version. To change it, update it or remove it first.

data.name: ModuleHasNoPreviousVersion
data.value: This module has no earlier version to go back to.

data.name: ModuleOperationFailed
data.value: The operation did not finish. The version that was running is still running. Please try again.

data.name: ModuleIdInvalid
data.value: The module name is not valid. Use lower case letters and digits, starting with a letter.

data.name: ModuleVersionInvalid
data.value: The version is not valid. Use a version number made of three numbers separated by dots.

data.name: MarketplaceChannelInvalid
data.value: The release channel is not valid. Use lower case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.

data.name: MarketplaceSearchInvalid
data.value: The search text is too long or contains characters that are not allowed.

data.name: MarketplaceCursorInvalid
data.value: The page marker is too long or contains characters that are not allowed.
